ICAP Server Resource Get ICAP Server
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/icapServers/:icapServerId

Get DLP server (i.e., for servers using ICAP) information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
icapServerId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the DLP server using ICAP.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The unique identifier for a DLP server.

name
string
REQUIRED

The DLP server name.

url
string
REQUIRED

The DLP server URL.

status
string
REQUIRED

The DLP server status

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED]
